channel.title: Gabon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gabon, every source cited.

item.title: Gabon civil society demands land deal explanation
item.description: 11 groups want parliament to question ministers over a plot given to the ruling party.

item.title: Gabon minister asks BEAC to ease property loan rules
item.description: Housing Minister Mays Mouissi met BEAC Governor Yvon Sana Bangui to discuss high interest rates and access to credit.

item.title: Gabon health ministry warns of late stroke treatment
item.description: Nearly 80% of stroke patients arrive at hospitals after the window for life-saving thrombolysis treatment has closed.

item.title: Gabon health minister inspects Mouila health facilities
item.description: Minister Elsa Nkana Bivigou reviewed services from regional health direction to a provincial training school.
